title: Element
description: One element's page (spec 3.2). Every displayed value is a Fact. An optional field is omitted when the source gives no value or it couldn't be verified; it is never filled with a guess. See verification/methodology.md for where each field comes from.

group.description: 1 to 18. Omitted for lanthanides and actinides, which PubChem doesn't place in a numbered group.

atomicWeight.description: Standard atomic weight (u). A number, or a range where IUPAC gives an interval because it varies in nature. Omitted for elements with no stable isotopes.

longestLivedIsotopeMassNumber.description: For elements with no natural isotopes: mass number of the longest-lived ground-state isotope in the AMDC (NUBASE) half-life table on PubChem (methodology section 8). This is a mass number, not an atomic weight, and is shown that way.

electronConfiguration.description: Normalized notation with spaces, e.g. "[Ar] 3d10 4s1". Compared with the source by parsed subshell occupancy, not by string. Uncertain when the source marks it predicted. Omitted when the contributors disagree (methodology section 5); the element still ships, without shells or valence.

electronegativity.description: Pauling scale. Omitted where the source has no value (e.g. most noble gases).

valenceElectrons.description: Derived (rule valence-main-group). Only for groups 1, 2 and 13 to 18, where the count is well defined. Omitted for transition metals, lanthanides and actinides, and when the configuration is only predicted.

state.description: State at room temperature, as the source words it (e.g. "Solid", "Expected to be a Gas").

isotopes.description: Isotopes listed in the source's isotope mass and abundance table.

atom.description: What the animated atom shows (spec 3.2): one specific isotope of the neutral atom.

isotope.description: Mass number of the isotope drawn: the most abundant natural isotope, or for elements with no natural abundance, longestLivedIsotopeMassNumber. The page names which one it is.

shells.description: Derived: shells-from-configuration. Electrons per shell, innermost first. Omitted when the electron configuration is.

story.description: Short plain-language statements, each supported by the cited History section.

uses.description: Short plain-language statements, each supported by the cited Uses section. Textbook level: never quantities or procedures.

abundance.description: Natural abundance as a fraction (0 to 1), or a range where IUPAC gives an interval. Omitted when the isotope doesn't occur naturally.

halfLife.description: Half-life from the IAEA Atomic Mass Data Center table: a number with its unit as the source writes it (e.g. 4.21 "My"), or the text "Stable".
